simple.meaning: יָמַשׁ (yâmash) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to touch.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Judges, beginning at Judges 16:26. The surrounding contexts include family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יָמַשׁ (H3237) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: יָמַשׁ (yâmash) / H3237 is traced through Judges 16:26 with source-language evidence and verse context.
